<definition>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement about misleading error messages that falsely indicate a Keelwater bug when the real cause is the customer's network failure. The five most similar stories (policyholder milestone notifications, workspace administration, activity timeline display, supplier contact details, claim information display) all address unrelated product areas with very low similarity scores (0.034-0.041), and none address error messaging, network failure diagnostics, or root-cause attribution.
